title: Spectral Archaeology: The Causal Topology of Model Evolution

bias_targets.methodology: Applying syntactic stress tests (e.g., active versus passive voice alternations) and measuring attention-graph spectral metrics (algebraic connectivity, smoothness, and spectral entropy) across 10 different languages to detect language-specific structural brittleness and disparate processing strategies.

Comparing internal attention-graph connectivity on canonical constructions versus non-canonical or complex constructions (e.g., passive voice vs. wh-questions) to reveal hyper-specialization and training data biases that prioritize formal logical structures over stylistic flexibility.
